patch_description: Replace the slope-lead compensation (which blends SG-smoothed slope with no gating) with the proven Gen-45/46 configuration: SG-smooth the RTS slope state only (no raw gradient component — that was the noise leak causing regression to 0.63), gate the lead with a sigmoid centered at 0.25·q_scale with temperature 0.15·q_scale so that near-flat (noise-dominated) slopes contribute no lead, and apply a conservative lead = 0.5·sg_half·0.25. This targets Gen-45's low lag (0.27) combined with Gen-46's smoothness (slope_changes ~97 → ~80) while keeping correlation ~0.97. Also add the localized reversal-suppression hysteresis pass (present in the 0.63-scoring variant) after lead compensation to kill residual micro-oscillations that drive false reversals.
